examples.sentence: I see you gather before me hungry terrified clutching your babes to your breast.
examples.chineseTranslation: 我看见你们饥肠辘辘、惶恐不安地聚到我面前，把孩子紧紧搂在胸口。

entries.meaningEN: (military, Ancient Rome) The major unit or division of the Roman army, usually comprising 3000 to 6000 infantry soldiers and 100 to 200 cavalry troops.
entries.meaningCN: （军事·古罗马）军团：古罗马军队的基本建制单位，通常由 3000 至 6000 名步兵和 100 至 200 名骑兵组成。

examples.sentence: Emperor Emre has marched his legions into our lands, laid siege to every fortress from here to the Blue Mountains, rabid and ravenous he bites and bites away.
examples.chineseTranslation: 埃姆雷皇帝已率军团杀进我们的国土，从这直到蓝山，沿途每一座堡垒都陷入围困；他疯癫狂乱、贪得无厌，一口又一口地噬咬不休。

entries.meaningEN: the action of an armed force that surrounds a fortified place and isolates it while continuing to attack
entries.meaningCN: 围攻；围困（包围要塞、孤立守军并持续攻击）。

entries.meaningCN: （引申）狂怒的；狂暴的；极其激烈的。

entries.meaningEN: Extremely hungry; devouring or craving food in great quantities.
entries.meaningCN: 极其饥饿的；狼吞虎咽的。

entries.meaningEN: (figurative) The brink of a dangerous situation.

examples.sentence: Men of the North, you stand at the precipice. Your kings have failed you, so now you turn to the gods.
examples.chineseTranslation: 北方的子民，你们已站在悬崖边缘。你们的君王辜负了你们，如今转而向诸神求告。
